title: Premises and transport access context
reason: Phase3 proposal only. Compelling connected civic/mobility story but highest bridge/right risk. Rank last for implementation; keep it as a conditional seventh target rather than force a feed-only demo into launch. ORR NLC/TLC→NaPTAN bridge and OGL scope unresolved; FSA FHRS/FHIS schemes, source ID reuse, private location suppression and freshness conditions matter. NaPTAN↔FSA requires independently approved CRS/axis/radius projection. Approximate distance is not route access or identity. NTA feed rights conflict; do not publish despite five accepted native GTFS edges. Irish GTFS and BODS/TfL are preserved alternate branches, not selected counts.
practical_value: 51.2/100 proposal value; readiness gated independently. I connect premises with explicit coordinates or known ATCO/locality IDs; request a scoped transport-stop lookup; inspect locality and dated usage/inspection context, distinguishing proximity from actual route accessibility.
showcase_value: 5/5, excluded from practical score; Which declared premises are near transport stops within an explicitly chosen distance?
